other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via frequency encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes category frequencies on a concatenated dataset of both train and test samples before splitting them back. This leaks information about the test set distribution into the training features.

summary: The agent develops a strong pipeline utilizing K-fold cross-validation, extensive feature engineering (including proper out-of-fold target encoding), and an optimized blend of LightGBM, XGBoost, and CatBoost. However, it fails to explicitly clean the data or handle outliers/duplicates, and it introduces a moderate data leak by computing frequency encoding on the combined train and test dataset before splitting.
